memoryBuilder.verseText: God is slow to get angry. His love is very great.

sequence.prompt: What happened with the twelve spies? Put it in order.

items.label: Moses sent twelve men to look at the land
Joshua and Caleb said, 'God is with us'

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they said or did.

pairs.right: Said the giants were too strong
Said 'Let us go — God is with us!'
Prayed and reminded God of His love

application.question: The ten measured the giants against themselves. What is your biggest 'giant' right now?
application.followUp: The giants were real — the ten were not lying about them. They just forgot to put God in the picture. Your giant is real too, and God is bigger than it.
